{{Quote|The ''Sedawan'' was carrying a supply of lightsaber crystals from Ilum.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="SW:TCW:JA" />}}
The '''''Sedawan''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]].<ref name="SW:TCW:JA" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Sedawanbridge.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] on the the ''Sedawan''{{'s}} bridge.]]

It was much larger than the CR-series corvettes, with 24 engines arranged in 4 rows of 6 engines each. With multiple hangars, at least one on each side of the main hull, the ''Sedawan'' could take on board several fighters and smaller transport vessels. Its bridge was substantially larger than the ones on the smaller CEC classes, having enough room for several crew members to walk around in.<ref name="SW:TCW:JA" />

==History==
The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was relegated to the transportation of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] from [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. It was decided by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] that the war made it too dangerous for [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] to build their lightsabers anywhere else but [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="SW:TCW:JA" />

During one of its journeys, it came under [[Battle on the Sedawan|attack]] from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces led by the ''[[Devastation]]'', but was not disabled before the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on board dispatched a distress signal to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. Jedi were sent to ascertain its fate, but found only an empty ship, apart from [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and several [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]].<ref name="SW:TCW:JA" />
